name: Tomato Soup
steps: Heat the 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced sweet onion, minced garlic and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups beef broth and add the 1 1/2 cups diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 20 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 1 tablespoon cilantro, and serve hot.
